title: Equiangular weighted frames and conical 2-designs with unequal traces
abstract: Conical 2-designs are families of positive operators possessing crucial symmetry properties that allow them to efficiently characterize important quantum measures. However, little is known about their general structures and properties. We propose a construction method of conical 2-designs whose elements are not of equal traces, based on a generalization of equiangular weighted frames to non-projective operators. We provide a detailed analysis of their properties, relations to quantum measurements, and applications, together with examples that go beyond the known classes. This constitutes a major step toward a full characterization of informationally overcomplete quantum measurements.
summary: This paper develops a rigorous mathematical framework to characterize conical 2-designs using generalized weighted frames. It proves that MU GEWFs form such designs under the condition of uniform parameter scaling across all frame sets. This advances the theory of informationally complete measurements in quantum systems.
main_problem: The primary goal is characterizing conical 2-designs, especially those whose constituent operators do not possess equal traces, to advance the understanding of informationally overcomplete quantum measurements.
main_result: It establishes that Mutually Unbiased Generalized Equiangular Weighted Frames (MU GEWFs) are special cases of conical 2-designs if and only if a characteristic parameter remains constant across all sets ($	ext{c}_\alpha \equiv c$).
method: The work employs generalizations of equiangular weighted frames to non-projective operators, utilizing detailed trace conditions and linear algebra proofs to construct and analyze these operator families.
model_or_system: The theory is developed for quantum systems on a $d$-dimensional (qudit) Hilbert space ($\mathbb{C}^d$), focusing on collections of semi-positive operators $\{R_{\alpha,k}\}$ that act as generalized measurements or frames.
key_observables: Conical 2-design parameters ($\kappa_+$, $\kappa_-$), the index of coincidence ($C(ho)$), and various trace conditions involving weights ($w_k$) and correlation terms ($	ext{Tr}(R_k R_\ell)$).
important_parameters: The dimension $d$ of the Hilbert space, the number of frames $N$, and characteristic parameters like $\gamma_\alpha$ and $c_\alpha$.
main_assumptions: Assumptions include assuming specific forms for auxiliary operators ($H_k$) during derivation, and noting that MU GEWFs are generally not POVMs.

paper_structure: The paper progresses by first defining Generalized Equiangular Weighted Frames (GEWFs), then constructing Mutually Unbiased GEWFs (MU GEWFs), and finally proving the equivalence conditions that link these frames to the definition of a conical 2-design, culminating in bounds on quantum information measures.
why_interesting: This work provides deep structural characterizations for measurement operators beyond simple projector measurements, which is crucial for understanding optimal quantum state tomography and quantum channel estimation.
